meta.name: audit
meta.description: Audit an inherited engagement or implementation against its evidence. Use when taking over work or joining mid-project; distinguish verified facts from inherited claims.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接手半途的工作,分清哪些是已证实的事实、哪些只是听来的说法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手别人留下的项目或工作,需要核实哪些结论真正可信
copy.tagline_en: Sort verified facts from inherited claims when taking over someone else's work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited a project or engagement and must tell verified facts from claims

howto.what: 接手项目时,Claude 会按证据审查既有的实现,产出结论时把已核实的事实与只是继承来的说法分开,未解的问题照实保留;缺的能力或没跑的检查会如实说明,不假装做过。
howto.when: 当你接手别人的工作、中途加入项目,或要对照证据核查已有实现时触发;由 @fde 调用时沿用它的当前范围,不重跑已答过的步骤和问题。

say.text: 我接手了这个项目,帮我对照证据审一遍现有实现
say.note: 会区分已核实事实与继承来的说法

say.text: 这份交接里的结论哪些能证实,哪些只是听说?
这项检查没跑,如实说明还缺什么能力

howto.what_en: On inherited work, Claude audits the existing implementation against its evidence, separating verified facts from claims it only inherited, and preserving unknowns. It honestly reports missing capabilities or checks it did not run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you take over someone else's work, join a project mid-way, or need to check an existing implementation against its evidence. When invoked by @fde, it reuses that scope and skips already-answered steps.

say_en.text: I inherited this project; audit the existing implementation against its evidence.
say_en.note: Separates verified facts from inherited claims

say_en.text: Which conclusions in this handover can be verified, and which are just claims?
This check wasn't run; state honestly what capability is missing.
say_en.note: It won't assume the capability exists
